name: Leva

skills.name: Dangerous Smile
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 7 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Rational Suppression
skills.description: Selects 1 direction, dealing AoE Electric damage equivalent to 120% ATK to all targets within a 7x3 area in the selected direction, applies Negative Charge for 2 turns, and generates Voltage tiles that lasts for 3 turns

skills.name: Ordered Disruption
skills.description: Selects a tile within a 7 tile radius and deals AoE Electric damage equivalent to 100% ATK to all targets within a 3 tile radius of the selected tile. Increases damage dealt by 30% and Stability damage dealt by 1 point against targets with Negative Charge

skills.name: Quantum Calculation
skills.description: Deals AoE Electric damage equivalent to 60% ATK to all targets within a 7 tile radius and generates Voltage tiles that lasts for 3 turns. Leva gains Overclock Strike for 3 turns. After attacking, Superconductive Strike can be used once

skills.name: Fox's Scheme
skills.description: At the start of the round or when triggering Tile Reaction for Voltage tiles, gains 1 stack of Superconductive Code. If Leva has Positive Charge, increases Electric damage dealt by 10%. If an enemy within Attack Range is applied with Negative Charge, performs one instance of Emergency Support, dealing melee Electric damage equivalent to 60% ATK and 1 Stability damage, and increases Confectance Index by 1 point. This effect can be triggered up to twice per round

skills.name: Superconductive Strike
skills.description:
Selects an enemy within a 7 tile radius, generates Voltage tiles within a 1 tile radius of the selected enemy for 3 turns, then deals melee Electric damage equivalent to 50% ATK to it

Consumes all stacks of Superconductive Code. Damage multiplier and Stability damage dealt is as follows:

1 stack - 60% ATK + 1 Stability damage
2 stacks - 70% ATK + 2 Stability damage
3 stacks - 85% ATK + 3 Stability damage
4 stacks - 120% ATK + 6 Stability damage

fortification.effect: Increases the maximum number of instances of Emergency Support by 1. If an enemy with Negative Charge within Attack Range dies, gains 1 stack of Superconductive Code. If Leva has Positive Charge, increases Electric damage dealt by 25% instead
Increases damage multiplier to 130%. At the end of the action, gains 1 stack of Superconductive Code

Superconductive Strike ignores 15% of the target's DEF, and gains 1 stack of Superconductive Code after skill usage. Damage multiplier and Stability damage dealt is increased as follows:

1 stack - 75% ATK + 1 Stability damage
2 stacks - 90% ATK + 2 Stability damage
3 stacks - 120% ATK + 4 Stability damage
4 stacks - 180% ATK + 8 Stability damage
Applies Paralysis to all targets within range for 2 turns. Increases CRIT DMG of this skill by 25%
Increases damage multiplier to 90%, and cleanses all debuffs on self before attacking. Increases damage multiplier for Overclock Strike to (Additional Stability damage x 8% ATK)

After using Rational Suppression or Ordered Disruption, Superconductive Strike can be used once

At the start of the turn, gains an additional stack of Superconductive Code. In a battle, when Leva gains 4 stacks of Superconductive Code, increases ATK by 15%

keys.name: Fixed Key 1 - Mature Aplomb
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, gains 2 stacks of Superconductive Code and 1 Confectance Index

keys.name: Fixed Key 2 - Fox's Smile
keys.effect: Increases damage dealt towards enemies in Stability Break by 7%

keys.name: Fixed Key 3 - Play It By Ear
keys.effect: Before performing Emergency Support, dispels 1 buff from the target

keys.name: Fixed Key 4 - Concealment Plan
keys.effect: After using Superconductive Strike, gains Concealed for 1 turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 5 - Rational Reaction
keys.effect: Before allies performs an active attack, applies Negative Charge to the enemy within range for 1 turn

keys.name: Fixed Key 6 - Always Prepared
keys.effect: At the start of the battle, gains Overclock Strike for 3 turns

keys.name: Common Key - Elite Agent
keys.effect: ATK +5.0% / Increases damage dealt towards enemies with Electric type debuffs by 7%

keys.name: Expansion Key - Electric Espionage
keys.effect: Support attacks and Superconductive Strike's range is increased to 9 tiles. Number of support attacks is increased by 1. Critical damage dealt is increased against enemies afflicted with Negative Charge by 7%. Critical damage dealt is further increased by 7% if target is in Stability Break. At the start of combat, with every Electric-element allies there are on the field Leva's Electric damage is increased by 2% and stability damage dealt is increased by 1.
